design_methods.practice_inference_es: Invitar a describir un hecho con palabras propias, sin respuestas modelo.
design_methods.practice_inference_en: Invite a description in the learner’s own words without model answers.

design_methods.practice_inference_es: Separar hecho, fecha, fuente y valoración en tarjetas distintas.
design_methods.practice_inference_en: Separate event, date, source and assessment into different cards.

design_methods.practice_inference_es: Nombrar el referente y condicionar lo que no se ha establecido. No deducir hechos del usuario.
design_methods.practice_inference_en: Name the referent and condition what has not been established. Do not infer user facts.

design_methods.practice_inference_es: Conservar aproximaciones y ofrecer pausa o paso como funciones de esta práctica, no promesas sobre el procedimiento oficial.
design_methods.practice_inference_en: Preserve approximations and offer pause or skip as practice features, not promises about the official procedure.

design_methods.practice_inference_es: Dar oportunidad de aclarar; cualquier comparación de declaraciones exige las dos citas reales y confirmación de que tratan del mismo asunto.
design_methods.practice_inference_en: Provide an opportunity to clarify; statement comparisons require both actual quotations and confirmation that they concern the same matter.

design_methods.practice_inference_es: Invitar a añadir información sin anunciar resultados jurídicos.
design_methods.practice_inference_en: Invite additional information without announcing legal outcomes.
